MHRC and MDOL, along with Clara Porter from Prevention, Action, Change, and Peter Lowe, Esq., from Brann & Isaacson, present a joint training on sexual harassment in the workplace. This training can be used by employers to comply with the 26 M.R.S. Section 807 requirement to provide training to new employees. Please note that presenting this training alone does not meet the training requirement for supervisory and managerial employees. This video is ASL-interpreted. — Maine Human Rights Commission — Latest News
